reconfigure.title: Update your L2 connection
reconfigure.description: Update the name or credentials for this same strip. Its Bluetooth address and device ID cannot be rebound to another device. Leave credential fields blank to keep saved values. Validation does not change the light.

manual.title: Connect a SONOFF L2 over Bluetooth
manual.description: Requires an L2 (UIID 137), a connectable Bluetooth adapter/proxy, and existing eWeLink credentials. Leave account apikey blank to use the device apikey for an owned device. Shared devices may need a different account apikey. Setup authenticates only; it does not change the light.

user.title: Set up SONOFF Bluetooth
user.description: Import your L2 credentials, or enter them manually. All control stays local after setup. Setup only authenticates; it does not change the light.

token.title: Import from eWeLink
token.description: Paste the region-prefixed token from SonoffLAN (for example eu:token). This contacts eWeLink to read your account and device keys. The token is not saved. An expired token must be replaced.

sonofflan.title: Choose an L2 strip
sonofflan.description: Only L2 devices (UIID 137) with available credentials are listed. SonoffLAN import reads its already-loaded records without logging in or changing that integration. If SonoffLAN is local-only without account details, the owner-key default is used; shared devices may require manual setup.

device.title: Choose an L2 strip
device.description: Only L2 devices (UIID 137) with available credentials are listed. SonoffLAN import reads its already-loaded records without logging in or changing that integration. If SonoffLAN is local-only without account details, the owner-key default is used; shared devices may require manual setup.

confirm.title: Confirm Bluetooth connection
confirm.description: Device ID: {device_id}. Matching connectable Bluetooth addresses: {addresses}. One match is filled automatically. If none is found, power on the strip, check your active proxy, then reopen this step; or enter its Bluetooth MAC manually. Multiple matches require choosing the correct address. Setup authenticates without changing the light.

reauth_confirm.title: Update L2 credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The strip explicitly rejected Bluetooth authentication. Enter the new device/account apikeys for this same strip. Blank key fields keep saved values; keys are never returned in this form. Validation only authenticates.

error.invalid_address: Use a Bluetooth MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_device_id: Use the 10-character hexadecimal eWeLink device ID.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Close eWeLink, check proximity, and ensure your ESPHome Bluetooth proxy is active.
error.auth_failed: Authentication or device identity check failed. Check the device apikey (not devicekey), device ID and firmware.
error.invalid_token: Token is invalid, rejected or expired. Use the complete region:token value from SonoffLAN.
error.cloud_failed: Could not read eWeLink account/device data. Check connectivity and retry.
error.invalid_device: Choose a device from the list.
error.identity_mismatch: Keep this strip’s original Bluetooth address and device ID. Add a different strip as a new integration.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth address is already configured.
abort.no_devices: No supported L2 devices with keys were found. Ensure SonoffLAN is loaded with its devices, try token import, or use manual setup.

init.title: Local Bluetooth options
init.description: Effects and controller-rhythm controls are enabled by default. State is refreshed at startup and every 60 seconds by default. Set polling to 0 to disable it, or use 30-3600 seconds. Each refresh briefly uses a local Bluetooth connection. Rhythm responds to sound at the controller; no phone or Home Assistant audio feed is needed. Larger Bluetooth packets are enabled by default, within adapter limits. Disable them to use conservative 20-byte writes if control becomes unreliable. Explicitly saved choices are preserved. Optional connection reuse keeps a proxy slot for up to 3 seconds between commands. It is not yet hardware-validated; disable it if control becomes unreliable.

data.reuse_connection: Reuse connection briefly (hardware test; default off)

error.invalid_interval: Use 0 to disable polling, or an integer from 30 to 3600 seconds.

auth_failed.message: The L2 rejected Bluetooth authentication. Update the integration credentials.

invalid_control.message: Invalid colour/effect combination. Check the active mode and effect options.

command_failed.message: The L2 Bluetooth command failed. Check proximity and credentials, then refresh state.

refresh_failed.message: The L2 did not provide a fresh state report. Check its power, proximity and active Bluetooth proxy.

invalid_number.message: Select a compatible effect first, and use an integer within the slider range.
